title: Turning tracking on gives a part with no bin the default bin at zero
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-TRKON-NOBIN-01) is active and untracked at {Location-A} and has no bin location: its Edit Inventory Part dialog shows no bin row.
custom_steps:
1. Search the part number of {Part-A} in Inventory.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch so it is on.
  4. Read the Inventory section.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Read the {Part-A} row in the list.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row and read the Inventory section.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The switch turns on and the Min and Max fields appear.
  • Steps 3 to 5: The dialog sends no turn-on request without a bin, so the refusal "At least one bin must be provided." can only come from a request made outside the dialog: this part cannot be checked by hand; write "not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 4: The Inventory section now holds one bin row: {Bin-A} with Quantity 0 and the Default pill.
  • Step 5: The dialog closes with no bin error.
  • Step 6: Total Qty shows "0 Available" (a number, not "Not Tracked"), and Bin Location / Quantity shows {Bin-A} with 0.
  • Step 7: The saved part keeps that one bin, {Bin-A}, Quantity 0, marked Default.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R7, S5-N1, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.6 (Switch back on) and tracking-note-5, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Set-up: a bin is optional while tracking is off (S4-R6). The QA lead's 9 Oct import route (Grid Location empty) no longer gives a part with no bin: PRD v29 S7-N10 and Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 3a) put such a part in a bin named "Unassigned". Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R7: “In the part dialog, when the user turns tracking on and the part has no bin location, the dialog gives it the location's default bin location, with a quantity of zero, marked as the default.”
  • S5-N1: “If a request to turn tracking on reaches the system with no bin location, it is refused with "At least one bin must be provided." The dialog never sends one, because of S5-R7.”
